Built on unified storage, it brings documents, emails, meeting materials, ticket attachments, contracts and archives under a shared storage and permissions framework.
在这套底座上，文件协同、工单、项目、会议、合同、客户、知识库、检索、档案和资产等: File collaboration, tickets, projects, meetings, contracts, customers, knowledge, search, archives and assets share this foundation. Information created during daily work is collected centrally and accessed according to permissions.

以下为交接资料中的平台产品技术设计。: The following describes the platform technology design in the handover materials.
Go 业务服务，围绕单机与双机部署组织服务。: Go-based business services organized around single-node and two-node deployment.
Vue 3 与 TypeScript，统一组件和界面规范。: Vue 3 and TypeScript with shared components and interface standards.
分布式对象存储，按节点和容量规划副本与保管策略。: Distributed object storage, with replicas and retention policies planned by node count and capacity.
MariaDB 与 openGauss 两类方案，按部署环境评估。: MariaDB and openGauss options, assessed against the deployment environment.
以容器组织组件，结合业务资源优先级安排任务。: Components organized in containers, with task allocation based on business resource priorities.
统一调度后台任务，按时间或事件触发。: Centrally scheduled background tasks triggered by time or event.
让交付材料可以核对: Make delivery materials easy to verify
产品设计将自研业务与第三方组件分别组织，通过清晰的服务接口协同。部署方案需说明组: The design separates in-house business services and third-party components, connected through clear service interfaces. Deployment materials should explain component purposes, versions and integration relationships.
随交付准备开源组件清单与对应许可证，便于客户核对使用条件。正式的组件范围与授权材: Prepare an open-source component list and corresponding licenses for delivery so customers can review usage conditions. Component scope and licensing materials will be confirmed before delivery.
把外发申请、审批处理和操作记录放进同一条链路，帮助管理员看清资料如何离开组织。: Connect outbound requests, approval handling and activity records so administrators can understand how information leaves the organization.
下列四类出口来自概念设计，实际通道和策略以确认后的范围为准。: The four channels below come from the concept design. Actual channels and policies depend on the confirmed scope.
根据资料类型和规则提示或限制。: Notify or restrict based on information type and rules.
按内容规则决定是否进入后续处理。: Use content rules to determine whether further handling is required.
将邮件相关外发纳入策略规划。: Include email-related outbound flows in policy planning.
选择资料，填写用途和接收方。: Select information and enter its purpose and recipients.
根据出口和内容规则判断是否进入审批。: Determine whether approval is required based on the channel and content rules.
审批人查看申请并记录处理意见。: Reviewers assess requests and record decisions.
申请人查进度，管理员按条件追溯。: Applicants check progress; administrators trace records by criteria.
审批条件、角色、撤回与驳回后的处理，等待业务规则确认。: Approval conditions, roles, withdrawal and post-rejection handling await confirmed business rules.
概念资料包含策略和模板配置，实际渲染方式和适用范围待确认。: The concept includes policy and template configuration. Rendering methods and applicability are pending confirmation.
